profile.headline: Java Developer at SAP Concur
profile.summary: I am passionate about creating software that can provide lasting change and a positive impact to as many people as possible. Throughout my professional career, I have developed and implemented numerous applications written in Java, VB, AWS, and even COBOL intended for government and public use.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Helped develop a replacement for an exchange rate microservice written in Clojure with a modern Java one using Spring Boot and Spring WebFlux. A new automated testing framework was also implemented for its business logic. This service currently processes ~120M requests per month and is used by thousands of Concur Travel and Expense Users.
• Built and maintained fully automated CI/CD pipelines for microservices by using Kubernetes, Docker, Quay, Helm, Vault, and Jenkins.
• Deployed microservices into a variety of secure cloud environments, including colo data centers, AWS, and AWS GovCloud.
• Pulled key service metrics from logging data using Kibana and New Relic's query languages into visualization dashboards to measure application performance.

positions.title: Programmer at KPG Inc
positions.description: Modernizing government technology at the Department of Treasury by building and implementing software solutions. Problem-solving through collaboration with government employees and developers to build a platform that will better serve the general public.

positions.title: Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU)
positions.description: Grant recipient for the Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU) program funded by the National Science Foundation (NSF). Implemented machine learning algorithms in C++ to prevent memory access leaks to adversaries.

positions.title: Intern Programmer
positions.description: Processing transactions in COBOL for a system running OpenVMS and generating reports with desired parameters.

positions.title: Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU)
positions.description: Grant recipient for the Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU) program funded by the National Science Foundation (NSF). Developed an organization-based access control topology aware adaptive security system in the ASP declarative language and the NetBeans IDE.
